blocks.text: The P50-million reward for the apprehension of fugitive Sen. Ronald Dela Rosa has “substantially narrowed" the movement of the lawmaker who has a standing arrest warrant from the International Criminal Court for charges of crimes against humanity, a Palace official said on Thursday.
